proofs.certificate: Deterministic membership+D6 replay for every r=1..64; exact set equality gives V=V0+6B where B is the canonical open-sector extra count.
D=2r+1 gives r=(D-1)/2. Substitute in V=1+3r(r+1)+6B: baseline term=(3D^2+1)/4; rearrange.
D6 symmetry and no axis-excess imply boundary states beyond the six constant-step sides occur in six sector images; define J as the canonical-sector boundary excess and substitute r=(D-1)/2.
Subtract V(r-1) from V(r): DeltaV=6r+6DeltaB. Subtract C=6r+6J.
